main_text.p: videntur; si liceat impune, si absit reprehendentium stomachus & irridentium ciconia. Ita est: amabili quadam deludimur insaniâ, dum posthabitâ Ratione ac Naturæ phænomenis, marte nostro Mundum digerimus: & sicut fabulam qui legunt, initio quidem fabulam esse, satis meminerunt: ideoq; non tam ea, quæ narrantur expendunt, quam narrandi modum, narrantisque indolem, affectus, ac studia; Longius autem provecti & inescati, totâ mente atque omni animo pendent: sperant modo, & modo metuunt, tum gemunt, & seriò tragicis illis nugis illacry-

page.notes: The faint marginal notes at the left edge are cut off and too fragmentary to read; they are not transcribed. The catchword "lacry-" is the start of the next word, printed at the foot of the column. Some letters in the scan are faint (e.g. "Mundum", "tum") but read as printed.
